prompt:
Live-action mythic modernism. Photoreal, tactile, cinematic, anamorphic widescreen, 24fps, shallow depth of field. FOUR SHOTS, cut in camera at the stated times, and no other coverage. All spoken dialogue is in ENGLISH.

CAMERA DOCTRINE: SHOTS 1, 2 AND 3 EACH CARRY ONE slow, smooth, continuous, dead-steady MECHANICAL DOLLY MOVE at a constant speed, beginning on the first frame and STILL MOVING WHEN THE SHOT CUTS — never accelerating, never stopping, never reversing. NOT handheld: no shake, no wobble, no whip pan. In each of those shots a named object sits CLOSE TO THE LENS and OUT OF FOCUS at one edge and slides across the frame faster than everything behind it, giving strong parallax. SHOT 4 IS ABSOLUTELY LOCKED: the camera stops because something is about to happen inside the frame.

REFERENCE PRECEDENCE: @Image1 IS THE AUTHORITY FOR THE CHAMBER in Shots 1, 3 and 4. @Image2 IS THE AUTHORITY FOR THE STONE AND THE SLOTS. @Image3 IS THE AUTHORITY FOR THE PIER OUTSIDE in Shot 2 — the frozen white lake, the flat white sky and the waiting people with their roped cases. @Image8 IS THE AUTHORITY FOR AMINA'S GLASS PODS on their thin dark articulated armatures.

THE CHAMBER: a small round room of COARSE, COLD, WEATHERED DARK GREY GRANITE, almost charcoal in shadow, salt-stained and pitted, laid in large heavy irregular blocks — NOT pale, NOT cream, NOT limestone. A row of small HORIZONTAL openings, each a hand's width across and only a few centimetres high, is cut into the curved wall at waist height with a thin warm amber light deep inside each one. Directly under them the stone sill is hollowed into a long smooth trough by four hundred years of hands. One stone bench. One plain doorway onto a flat white sky and the frozen pier. NO MACHINERY ANYWHERE.

LIGHT: TWO PRACTICAL LIGHT SOURCES, NEVER BLENDED, NEITHER WITH A VISIBLE FIXTURE: COLD blue-white 6500K daylight through the doorway, and WARM amber 3200K from deep inside the slots. IN SHOTS 1, 3 AND 4 every face inside the chamber is lit cold on one side and warm on the other. SHOT 2 IS THE DELIBERATE EXCEPTION AND IT IS PART OF THIS RULE: Shot 2 happens OUTSIDE, on the open pier, with the chamber BEHIND THE CAMERA, so the only light in that shot is flat cold white daylight.

ALL FOUR PEOPLE ARE STANDING ON THEIR FEET. NOBODY SITS DOWN AT ANY POINT and THE STONE BENCH STAYS EMPTY. Inside the chamber everyone stands A CLEAR METRE BACK FROM THE WALL, arms down, hands at their sides, and the band of stone floor between them and the slots stays empty. NOBODY TOUCHES THE WALL.

CAST:
@Image4 and @Image5 are BEATRICE MORD — a WOMAN in her early forties, dark hair in a TIGHT HIGH TOPKNOT, clean-shaven, in a BLACK ASYMMETRICAL WRAP COAT wrapped and belted across the body over a full-length OXBLOOD-AND-RUST underskirt panel. She has NO cream panel, NO tall collar, NO cuffs, NO ribbon, NO blue, NO rust sash, NO leather chest strap, NO glass cylinders, NO earrings and NO veil.
@Image6 is TOMAS GREY — a MAN in his thirties, tall, OLIVE-SKINNED, dark CURLY hair and a SHORT DARK BEARD. @Image6 IS THE ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY FOR TOMAS — his face, his collar, his cuffs, his coat and the black ribbon around him — AND IT OVERRIDES EVERY OTHER IMAGE AND EVERY WORD OF DESCRIPTION ON THAT SUBJECT. COPY HIS COSTUME FROM IT EXACTLY: a floor-length BLACK ROBE-COAT with ONE FLAT CREAM-OATMEAL LINEN PANEL down the centre front, TURNED-BACK CREAM CUFFS at both wrists, a TALL SMOOTH CYLINDRICAL CREAM COLLAR wrapped close around his throat with a level top edge — a smooth closed tube, never flared, never a wing, never a scallop, never two upright panels — and THE CLAUSE RIBBON, a long matte black band covered in fine pale engraved script, LOOPING AND SPIRALLING AROUND HIS BODY in large open curves and standing away from him in the air. THERE IS ONLY ONE TOMAS IN THIS FILM.
@Image7 is DR. AMINA VEY — a woman in her forties with LIGHT BROWN SKIN and DARK CURLY HAIR in a LOOSE MESSY BUN with strands escaping. Layered SLATE-BLUE technical workwear with a high draped cowl collar, a LEATHER STRAP across the chest, a WIDE OXBLOOD-RUST SASH, heavy laced BOOTS, small CLEAR GLASS-AND-CERAMIC SAMPLE PODS riding on thin dark articulated metal armatures off her harness, and an open field notebook. She is the ONLY person here in blue. She wears NO black column, NO rectangular panels, NO braided crown and NO drop earrings.
@Image9 is PIKK — compact, bald, LONG POINTED EARS, olive-grey skin, a deeply lined middle-aged adult face, soot-grey workwear with flat tan-ochre panels; his ears are OPAQUE and MATTE, never backlit. HIS RIGHT HAND IS CLOSED INSIDE HIS COAT POCKET, visible only as a fist-shape pushing out the cloth; his LEFT hand does everything. Nobody looks at it and nobody mentions it.

THE PODS — THE BUTTON OF THIS FILM, SET UP IN EARLIER SCENES: Amina's glass pods swing on their armatures to point at whatever the route is drawing from, the way they swung toward the frozen man. Until the last shot they hang loosely at her sides.

=== SHOT 1 — 0:00 to 0:05 — MEDIUM, 50mm, LATERAL TRACK ALONG THE WALL — NO DIALOGUE ===
NOBODY SPEAKS IN THIS SHOT.

The camera is LOW, its lens level with the hollowed trough, looking ALONG the curved wall so the small amber slots and the worn trough recede in perspective, the bright doorway beyond. THE MOVE: THE CAMERA TRACKS SLOWLY AND CONTINUOUSLY SIDEWAYS along the wall, following the curve, THE WAY A HAND USED TO. Right up against the lens and out of focus, the worn trough and the near lip of the slots STREAM PAST, much faster than the people beyond them, and the four figures are revealed one after another: PIKK, his right hand a fist in his pocket; AMINA, her notebook open, her pencil moving steadily down the last column; TOMAS, still; and BEATRICE, nearest the doorway, who turns and walks out through it onto the pier as the shot ends.

CUT at 0:05.

=== SHOT 2 — 0:05 to 0:16 — CLOSE-UP, 85mm, OUTSIDE ON THE PIER, SLOW PUSH ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT:
BEATRICE (reporting, flat, procedural, throwing it away): "Forty-one boarded. Forty of them were being polite. One of them meant it."
(a beat in which she does not react to her own sentence)
BEATRICE (the same flat voice): "He wasn't murdered. He was the only thing plugged in."
PIKK (off screen, from inside the chamber, a classification correction and the angriest he has been all day): "He wasn't a passenger. He was infrastructure."

BEATRICE STANDS OUTSIDE, ON THE OPEN PIER, a step beyond the doorway, FACING THE LENS. THE CAMERA IS OUT ON THE PIER WITH HER AND THE CHAMBER IS BEHIND THE CAMERA. Behind her head there is only the FLAT WHITE SKY and the FROZEN WHITE LAKE, with small out-of-focus waiting figures far along the pier. THE ONLY LIGHT ON HER IS FLAT COLD WHITE DAYLIGHT, keying her face fully and evenly from the front. No slot, no lamp and no warm source exists anywhere in this shot. Her breath is visible in the cold. Her whole head is inside the frame with clear space above it. THE MOVE: THE CAMERA PUSHES IN ON HER FACE VERY SLOWLY AND CONTINUOUSLY, and a roped suitcase close to the lens at one edge slides out of shot as it advances.
SHE REPORTS; SHE DOES NOT PERFORM THE DEDUCTION. No triumph, no pause before any good line.

CUT at 0:16.

=== SHOT 3 — 0:16 to 0:25 — CLOSE-UP, 85mm, INSIDE, SLOW DOLLY IN ON TOMAS — HE IS LARGE ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT:
TOMAS (quietly, still looking at the wall, heavier than the first time he said it): "He volunteered to a route that had closed every other door. That is not consent. That is the last option wearing a signature."

Back inside the chamber. A LARGE FRONT-ON CLOSE-UP OF TOMAS, his head and shoulders filling the frame, THE TALL SMOOTH CREAM TUBE COLLAR plainly across the bottom of frame and THE ENGRAVED BLACK RIBBON arcing past his shoulder. Warm amber on the wall side of his face, cold on the doorway side. The air in front of his face is completely clear. THE MOVE: a slow continuous dolly in, the dark curve of the wall sliding past close to the lens, still advancing at the cut. NOBODY ARGUES WITH HIM AND NOBODY ANSWERS HIM.

CUT at 0:25.

=== SHOT 4 — 0:25 to 0:30 — MEDIUM CLOSE, 50mm, ABSOLUTELY LOCKED — THE PODS TURN ===
SPOKEN IN THIS SHOT, AS ITS FIRST SOUND:
BEATRICE (off screen, from the doorway, the next procedural step, without heat): "Then I want the name on the consolidation order."
AFTER THAT LINE NOBODY SPEAKS AGAIN.

Inside the chamber. AMINA stands at FRAME RIGHT, close to the lens and large, her face sharp, her open notebook in her hands, her GLASS PODS on their armatures hanging at her shoulder in the near foreground. THE BRIGHT DOORWAY IS AT THE FAR LEFT EDGE OF THE FRAME, partially cropped by it, and BEATRICE STANDS IN IT — small, backlit by the white sky, a dark figure in a bright rectangle, her breath visible.
AS BEATRICE FINISHES HER LINE, ALL OF AMINA'S GLASS PODS SWING ROUND ON THEIR ARMATURES AT ONCE — smoothly, all together, like a row of heads turning — AND LOCK WITH ONE HARD MECHANICAL CLICK, ALL OF THEM POINTING ACROSS THE CHAMBER AT THE DOORWAY, AT BEATRICE. Amina looks down at the pods. Then she looks up across the chamber at Beatrice in the doorway. HER PENCIL STOPS ON THE PAGE. She says nothing. Beatrice does not notice and does not look at the pods. END on Amina looking at Beatrice.

SOUND: flat continuous cold wind at the doorway, cut off abruptly by the stone; outside on the pier the wind is open and wide. The chamber has a tight dry acoustic with NO reverb tail. THE SLOT RANK IS SILENT. The pods' single hard click in Shot 4. NO music, no score, no swells, no drone and no stingers at any point, and no sound cue on the pods. ALL BACKGROUND VOICES ARE LOW AND COMPLETELY INDISTINCT AND NO WORD IN THEM CAN BE MADE OUT; only the named lines in this film are intelligible.

Pronounce these words exactly and clearly: BOARDED, POLITE, MURDERED, PLUGGED, INFRASTRUCTURE, VOLUNTEERED, CONSENT, SIGNATURE, CONSOLIDATION.

PALETTE: worn stone #B9B1A2, slot amber #A9721F, pier blue #8FA3B0, frost white #E9F1F4.

PHYSICS: nothing glows anywhere except the faint amber inside the slots, which never changes in this film. The pods are mechanical, never glow and make no sound except their click. No machinery, no gears, no runes, no magical light, no lens flare, no particles, no smoke, no digital element, no screens, no interface, no signage, no ornament, and no Victorian, Edwardian, medieval or steampunk detail.
